Simple rules that make
a man's life easier
If it takes two minutes, do it now. Reply to the email, wash the cup, pay the bill. Small tasks only become heavy when you let them pile up for days.
Put things back where they belong. Keys, wallet, charger. One fixed place for everything saves you hours of searching every year. Do it on day one.
Never go food shopping hungry. You'll spend more and buy worse. A full stomach and a short list keep your money and your health in check.
Prepare tomorrow tonight. Clothes ready, bag packed, plan written. Your morning self will thank you for every decision you already made.
Before: my evenings disappeared into scrolling. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I end every day a little sharper.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: my evenings disappeared into scrolling. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I end every day a little sharper.

slides.texte_overlay: Sleep on big decisions. A night's sleep turns many urgent problems into simple ones. Very few choices really need an answer tonight.
Buy fewer, better things. One good jacket beats three cheap ones. Quality saves money over time and makes life feel less cluttered.
